knowledge:
- key_parameters: size=removes nodes by residing subgraph sizes in clean_graph ;; damping=re-calculates PageRank with updated damping factor in adjust_graph ;; method=specifies the method (e.g., "difference") to filter GRNs in P_graph ;; threshold=statistical significance threshold for keeping regulator-target pairs in P_graph
- alternatives: ARACNe or other reverse engineering algorithms ;; can be used to generate the initial GRN, which can then be reformatted using aracne_network if stored in a regulon object
- when_to_use: Use when prioritizing key transcription factors (TFs) in gene regulatory networks (GRNs) using temporal or multiplex PageRank, especially when integrating multi-omics data (ATAC-Seq, HiChIP, RNA-Seq)
- pitfalls: Input graphs for diff_graph and multiplex_page_rank must have vertex attributes "name" (and "pagerank" for multiplex) ;; aracne_network expects a regulon object as input ;; accessibility_network and conformation_network require specific genome assemblies and matching promoter/PFM annotations

workflows.name: temporal_pagerank
workflows.intent: Calculate temporal PageRank on two temporally adjacent graphs to identify gained and lost interactions.
input: graph1.RData (igraph object representing the first network)
graph2.RData (igraph object representing the second network)
workflows.stages: 1. Load or create two igraph objects ;; 2. Assign vertex names to both graphs ;; 3. Calculate temporal PageRank using diff_graph
workflows.code:
library(pageRank)
set.seed(1)
graph1 <- igraph::erdos.renyi.game(100, 0.01, directed = TRUE)
igraph::V(graph1)$name <- 1:100
#the 1st graph with name as vertex attributes
set.seed(2)
graph2 <- igraph::erdos.renyi.game(100, 0.01, directed = TRUE)
igraph::V(graph2)$name <- 1:100
#the 2nd graph with name as vertex attributes
diff_graph(graph1, graph2)

workflows.name: multiplex_pagerank
workflows.intent: Calculate multiplex PageRank using a base network and a supplemental network.
input: base_graph.RData (igraph object representing the base network)
supp_graph.RData (igraph object representing the supplemental network)
workflows.stages: 1. Load or create base and supplemental igraph objects ;; 2. Assign vertex names and pre-calculate standard PageRank for both graphs ;; 3. Calculate multiplex PageRank using multiplex_page_rank
workflows.code:
set.seed(1)
graph1 <- igraph::erdos.renyi.game(100, 0.01, directed = TRUE)
igraph::V(graph1)$name <- 1:100
igraph::V(graph1)$pagerank <- igraph::page_rank(graph1)$vector
#the base graph with pagerank and name as vertex attributes.
set.seed(2)
graph2 <- igraph::erdos.renyi.game(100, 0.01, directed = TRUE)
igraph::V(graph2)$name <- 1:100
igraph::V(graph2)$pagerank <- igraph::page_rank(graph2)$vector
#the supplemental graph with pagerank and name as vertex attributes.
multiplex_page_rank(graph1, graph2)

workflows.name: graph_cleaning_and_adjustment
workflows.intent: Clean a graph by removing small subgraphs and adjust PageRank calculations with updated parameters.
input: raw_graph.RData (igraph object with vertex names and pre-calculated pagerank)
workflows.stages: 1. Clean the graph using clean_graph based on subgraph size ;; 2. Recalculate/adjust PageRank using adjust_graph with a new damping factor
workflows.code:
set.seed(1)
graph <- igraph::erdos.renyi.game(100, 0.01, directed = TRUE)
igraph::V(graph)$name <- 1:100
igraph::V(graph)$pagerank <- igraph::page_rank(graph)$vector
#the graph to be cleaned, with pagerank and name as vertex attributes.
clean_graph(graph, size=5)

set.seed(1)
graph <- igraph::erdos.renyi.game(100, 0.01, directed = TRUE)
igraph::V(graph)$name <- 1:100
igraph::V(graph)$pagerank <- igraph::page_rank(graph, damping=0.85)$vector
#the graph to be adjusted, with pagerank and name as vertex attributes.
adjust_graph(graph, damping=0.1)

workflows.name: accessibility_grn_generation
workflows.intent: Build a gene regulatory network from chromatin accessibility peaks and regulator position frequency matrices (PFMs).
workflows.stages: 1. Define peak regions, promoter regions, and regulator PFMs ;; 2. Build the network using accessibility_network
workflows.code:
table <- data.frame(Chr=c("chr1", "chr1"), Start=c(713689, 856337), End=c(714685, 862152),
                    row.names=c("A", "B"), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
regulators=c("FOXF2", "MZF1")
#peaks and regulators to be analyzed

library(GenomicRanges)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(annotate)
promoter <- promoters(genes(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene))
names(promoter) <- getSYMBOL(names(promoter), data="org.Hs.eg")
promoter <- promoter[!is.na(names(promoter))]
#get promoter regions

library(JASPAR2018)
library(TFBSTools)
library(motifmatchr)
pfm <- getMatrixSet(JASPAR2018, list(species="Homo sapiens"))
pfm <- pfm[unlist(lapply(pfm, function(x) name(x))) %in% regulators]
#get regulator position frequency matrix (PFM) list

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
accessibility_network(table, promoter, pfm, "BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19")

workflows.name: conformation_grn_generation
workflows.intent: Build a gene regulatory network from chromosome conformation records and regulator position frequency matrices (PFMs).
workflows.stages: 1. Define conformation interaction regions, promoter regions, and regulator PFMs ;; 2. Build the network using conformation_network
workflows.code:
table <- data.frame(Chr1=c("chr1", "chr1"), Position1=c(569265, 713603), Strand1=c("+", "+"),
                    Chr2=c("chr4", "chr1"), Position2=c(206628, 715110), Strand2=c("+", "-"),
                    row.names=c("A", "B"), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
regulators=c("FOXF2", "MZF1")
#peaks and regulators to be analyzed

promoter <- promoters(genes(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene))
names(promoter) <- getSYMBOL(names(promoter), data="org.Hs.eg")
promoter <- promoter[!is.na(names(promoter))]
#get promoter regions

pfm <- getMatrixSet(JASPAR2018, list(species="Homo sapiens"))
pfm <- pfm[unlist(lapply(pfm, function(x) name(x))) %in% regulators]
#get regulator position frequency matrix (PFM) list

conformation_network(table, promoter, pfm, "BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19")

workflows.name: grn_filtering_expression
workflows.intent: Filter a gene regulatory network using joint and marginal probability distributions from expression data.
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare expression matrix and network data frame ;; 2. Filter the network using P_graph
workflows.code:
dset <- exprs(dset)
net <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:10, function(i, regulon){
  data.frame(reg=rep(names(regulon)[i], 10),
             target=names(regulon[[i]][[1]])[1:10],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)}, regulon=regulon))
P_graph(dset, net, method="difference", null=NULL, threshold=0.05)
